== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Give Yourself To The Dark Side (Errata)]] (<code>1281_18</code>, Virtual Block 8.1 slip 00), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-00-Give_Yourself_To_The_Dark_Side.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-giveyourselftothedarkside-pre.gif]]) show the original text of [[Give Yourself To The Dark Side]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-01-11], Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “If Bring Him Before Me on table, play instead of a Starting Interrupt. ▼ an Endor site and two always-[Immune to Alter] Effects. Deploy on table; may ▲ and stack Son of Vader here. A Powerful Ally: While Son of Vader on table, Jedi, Rebels, and Rebel Starships lose all immunity to attrition and opponent loses 1 Force at the end of each turn. When Son Of Vader leaves table, stack him here. If Luke crossed over, Your Destiny is lost and may deploy (or persona replace) Son of Vader as if from hand.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1281_18</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 8 set mark, original-title strip, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
